issues.reason: *Names and casing* makes a capitalized PLURAL kind-word label a Name-only individual — "one symbol, Name atom, no GroupOf and no per-member kind from the label word (the members need not be wrens; a type atom is never invented)" — so (GroupOf sk_keepers_1 keeper) asserts a member kind the rule forbids, and the mandatory Name atom is absent.

defect_summary: Compliant form: a single symbol (e.g. keepers) with (Name keepers "Keepers") and no claim about its members — the GroupOf atom dropped entirely — filling the Agent slot of the record event; the redistribution, Watch-ledger and role atoms are unaffected.
notes: (Location sk_record_1 sk_ledgers_1) is a defensible where-reading but competes with the preposition-named In the instruction set uses for a medium ("in a statement"); it was not filed as an issue and does not bear on the decision.
